description: Self-hosted personal data broker removal system — complete design documentation

technology_stack.frontend: React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS / Nginx Alpine

documents.title: Requirements Specification
documents.summary: 10 Functional Requirements (FR-1 to FR-10) and 10 Technical Requirements (TR-1 to TR-10) with full traceability matrix
key_decisions: Fully automatic removal — no human approval needed
Daily scans
Multi-profile household (2-5 members)
Docker Compose single-host deployment
Versioned profile fields with historical address retention

documents.title: System Architecture
documents.summary: 9-service Docker Compose topology across 3 tiers: LAN-facing (api, frontend, n8n), data layer (PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery), automation (Playwright, Mailwatcher)
key_decisions: Two Docker networks: opendataremoval_net (internal) + opendataremoval_egress (internet)
Playwright and Mailwatcher on egress network only
HOST_BIND_ADDRESS env var for Cloudflare Tunnel compatibility
8GB RAM with 4.4GB allocated across services

documents.title: Database Schema Design
documents.summary: 34 tables across 9 schemas + archive schema. PostgreSQL 15 with pgcrypto PII encryption.
key_decisions: profile_fields is EAV — unlimited phones, addresses, emails per profile
Versioned profile fields with effective_from/effective_to
One removal_request per detection event with parent_request_id for re-listing chains
Raw email body stored as TEXT in inbound_messages
Daily exposure score + per-broker snapshot in reporting schema
Archive schema populated before hard delete (8-step transaction)

documents.title: Docker Compose Scaffold
documents.summary: Complete docker-compose.yml, .env.example (all 30+ variables), init.sh (10-step setup), Dockerfiles, nginx.conf, postgres init.sql, .gitignore, and operational command reference
key_decisions: Mailgun as recommended SMTP/IMAP provider with custom domain
Direct residential IP — PLAYWRIGHT_PROXY_URL as optional placeholder
Manual Docker image updates via docker compose pull
init.sh automates first-run from zero to running stack

documents.title: API Specification
documents.summary: 38 endpoints across 9 routers with OpenAPI-style schemas, custom error envelope, cursor pagination, WebSocket notifications, and SSE scan progress
key_decisions: Custom error envelope with machine-readable error_code field
Cursor-based pagination on audit_log, scan_results, removal_requests only
SSE for scan progress (token in query param — EventSource limitation)
WebSocket for notifications (Redis pub/sub fanout)
HMAC-SHA256 for n8n webhook (not JWT)

documents.title: Broker Playbook JSON Schema
documents.summary: JSON Schema spec for broker automation playbooks with 3 complexity levels, 16 action types, 16 token interpolation values, formal JSON Schema, and 3 complete worked examples
key_decisions: Phase-based structure: search, identify, optout, verify, email_loop
Only 'submit' action skipped in dry_run mode
Confirmation detection: text match OR URL pattern — whichever fires first
CAPTCHA default strategy: manual (upgradeable to 2captcha/anticaptcha per broker)
Versioned playbooks — prior versions retained for rollback

documents.title: Celery Task Catalogue
documents.summary: 21 Celery tasks across 6 groups (scanning, requests, maintenance, registry, notifications, reports) with inputs, outputs, retry policies, failure escalation, Beat schedule, and dependency map
key_decisions: Batched parallel scan dispatch — 10 brokers per batch via Celery chord
Chord callback triggers post-scan analytics automatically on batch completion
Retry up to max_retries then escalate to requires_manual status
CCPA/GDPR PDFs generated, stored on volume, and emailed as attachment
Hourly process_due_followups as safety net for missed ETA dispatches
All outbound actions write audit_log BEFORE executing

documents.title: Playwright Executor Specification
documents.summary: Full specification for the Playwright microservice — browser pool, async job API, action handlers, token resolution, error classification, screenshot storage, captcha handling, and worker integration pattern
key_decisions: Pool of N BrowserContext objects (default 3) — shared Browser, isolated contexts per job
Async job pattern — worker POSTs and polls GET /jobs/{job_id} every 5 seconds
Structured error types with auto-screenshot on every failure
Structured subdirectory tree: screenshots/{profile_id}/{broker_id}/{timestamp}_{step}_{type}.png
Curated built-in UA pool per browser type — no runtime external dependency
Playwright service does not write to DB — all DB writes done by worker after receiving result

documents.title: Mailwatcher Service Specification
documents.summary: Full specification for the IMAP polling service — poll loop, email parser, keyword+regex classifier, request matcher, verification link extractor with automatic dispatch, task dispatcher, patterns.yml format, and deduplication
key_decisions: Keyword pre-filter + regex two-stage classification engine
Sender domain + subject line combined for request matching
Move to IMAP Processed folder after processing — preserves for human review
Verification links automatically extracted and dispatched to Playwright via Celery
patterns.yml hot-reloaded each poll cycle — zero-downtime pattern updates
Deduplication via message_id_header prevents double-processing on restart

documents.title: n8n Workflow Specification
documents.summary: 5-workflow broker discovery system — orchestrator/sub-workflow architecture, Markdown/JSON/CSV parsing, full normalisation, HMAC-signed batch posting, retry logic, and workflow versioning
key_decisions: Orchestrator (WF-001) triggers sub-workflows per source — failed sources don't block others
50 brokers per POST batch — avoids body size limits, natural retry unit
3 retries per source fetch + 3 retries per batch POST before continuing
n8n handles full normalisation — API receives clean validated broker schema
HMAC-SHA256 signed via Code node using Node.js crypto module
patterns.yml-style normalisation rules embedded in Code nodes

documents.title: Frontend Dashboard Specification
documents.summary: Full frontend spec — React 18 + Vite + Tailwind, Zustand stores, TanStack Query, WebSocket/SSE hooks, component tree, routing, colour system, page layouts, score gauge, onboarding wizard
key_decisions: Zustand for client state (auth token, theme, notifications, scan progress)
TanStack Query for all server state with smart invalidation on WebSocket events
Polished dark/light mode with colour-coded status system and animated score gauges
Desktop-first 1280px+ with sidebar icon collapse at 768px
JWT stored in Zustand memory only — never localStorage
WebSocket managed in single hook, SSE per active scan view

documents.title: Security & Secrets Management Specification
documents.summary: Threat model, secrets inventory (10 secrets with generation/rotation/compromise procedures), GPG-encrypted backup, manual rotation procedures including DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY PII re-encryption sequence, pg_dump + volume tar backup/restore, host hardening (UFW + fail2ban + checklist), and 12-point security verification checklist
key_decisions: .env file + GPG-symmetric encrypted backup stored outside project directory
Manual rotation with documented per-secret procedures — no automated rotation
DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY rotation requires full backup + PII re-encryption migration script
pg_dump for consistent DB backup + volume tar for n8n and screenshots, all GPG-encrypted
UFW rules restrict LAN ports to home subnet only
fail2ban protects SSH and OpenDataRemoval login endpoint

documents.title: Testing & QA Specification
documents.summary: pytest + Vitest + Playwright Test Runner — testcontainers PostgreSQL, fake Playwright service, aiosmtpd fake SMTP, E2E against live Docker Compose stack with fake broker server, full directory structure, unit/integration/E2E test specs, 13 named critical paths, 80%/75% coverage gates, MSW handlers, component and store tests
key_decisions: pytest + Vitest + Playwright Test Runner (full stack coverage)
testcontainers PostgreSQL — real pgcrypto and UUID support
Fake Playwright FastAPI service + aiosmtpd for test doubles
Coverage targets: 80% backend, 75% frontend
10 named critical paths that must all pass regardless of coverage
Savepoint-based transaction rollback per test — no state leakage between tests
E2E tests run against dedicated test Docker Compose stack — never touches production volumes
Fake broker HTTP server for E2E testing — Playwright executor scans against it instead of real sites

documents.title: Operations & Runbook
documents.summary: Daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly maintenance schedules, Docker + Alembic + playbook upgrade procedures, 14 symptom-based troubleshooting guides with component-level diagnosis steps, common operational tasks, and log location reference
key_decisions: Symptom index maps to component diagnosis — organised by what operator sees, not by service
Weekly + monthly + quarterly maintenance cadence
Docker images + Python/Node deps + Alembic migration guide for upgrades
14 troubleshooting scenarios covering all realistic failure modes

documents.title: Implementation Checklist
documents.summary: 11-phase implementation roadmap with 44 tasks, each with deliverables and acceptance criteria. References all 14 prior documents. Covers stack foundation through E2E verification and operations setup. Total: 22-32 developer days, 6-8 weeks solo.
key_decisions: Phases ordered by dependency — DB before API, API before workers, workers before frontend
Every task has acceptance criteria — definition of done is unambiguous
13 critical paths must all pass for completion
Phases 4, 7, and parts of 8 can be parallelised

documents.title: Agent Sprint Plan
documents.summary: 7 sprints (39 tasks) with file-level deliverables, implementation notes, exact verify commands, and sprint gate checks. Covers full stack build from repo initialisation through live household onboarding.
key_decisions: 7 sprints: Foundation+DB, Core API, Playwright, Workers+Mailwatcher, Remaining API+Frontend base, Pages+E2E, Security+Ops
Each task specifies exact files_to_create, implementation_notes, and verify.commands
Sprint gate_checks block sprint progression until all pass
Critical path tests embedded as acceptance criteria throughout
All 13 CPs achieved across Sprints 2-6 before final sign-off

document_relationships.requirements_to_architecture: FR/TR map directly to services in architecture (TR-1 = service topology, TR-3 = api service, etc.)
document_relationships.architecture_to_schema: All services read/write to PostgreSQL schemas defined in DOC-3
document_relationships.schema_to_api: API endpoints read/write the tables defined in DOC-3 (profiles, scan_results, removal_requests, etc.)
document_relationships.compose_to_architecture: DOC-4 docker-compose.yml implements the 9-service topology from DOC-2
document_relationships.playbook_to_scanning: registry.broker_playbooks.playbook_json (DOC-3) validated against DOC-6 JSON Schema

implementation_order: 1. Set up Docker Compose stack from DOC-4 — init.sh creates DB, migrates, seeds registry
2. Implement database schemas from DOC-3 using Alembic migrations
3. Build FastAPI API from DOC-5 endpoint specs — start with auth, profiles, brokers
4. Build Playwright microservice consuming playbooks defined in DOC-6
5. Build Mailwatcher IMAP poller and classifier
6. Build Celery worker tasks for scan dispatch and removal workflow
8. Build React dashboard consuming DOC-5 API
9. Implement Celery tasks from DOC-7 — start with scan_broker, then execute_removal_request chain
10. Build playwright/ microservice from DOC-8 — start with pool.py and action handlers
11. Build mailwatcher/ service from DOC-9 — start with imap_client.py and classifier.py
12. Import n8n workflows from DOC-10 workflows/ files and run initial discovery to seed broker registry
13. Build React frontend from DOC-11 — start with authStore, api/client.js, AppLayout, then page by page
14. Apply security hardening from DOC-12 after stack is running — UFW, fail2ban, permissions, backup schedule
15. Write tests from DOC-13 alongside feature implementation — start with critical path tests CP-01 through CP-04
16. Follow DOC-15 Implementation Checklist phase by phase — the complete build guide
